summary: End-to-end validation of the new Event Report feature (Staff/Admin). Backend pytest 12/12 PASS on /app/backend/tests/test_event_report.py covering endpoint shape, KPIs, daily series (14 days), pain population in rich range, >=5 insights, team filter, empty future range (N/A), individual athlete endpoint, and access control (athlete -> 403, unauthenticated -> 401). Frontend live UI on preview URL verified: nav link, all 15 sections, KPI cards, filters (date + team + view), Executive/Complete view switching hides/shows sections correctly, athlete modal opens via risk-row click and shows Individual Report with summary + readiness sparkline + pain regions, CSV export downloads file 'event-report_2026-06-05_2026-06-18.csv', team comparison headers 'Metric/All/Men/Women/Interpretation', empty-range 2026-08-01..08-05 shows N/A / Insufficient data on all sections without crash.

issues: Radix a11y warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Add a DialogDescription (or VisuallyHidden Description) inside DialogContent to silence the warning.

Many console warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' fire during first paint (before ChartFrame gets its measured height). Non-blocking but noisy. Consider giving ChartFrame an explicit minHeight or rendering charts only after the wrapper has measured size.

action_items: OPTIONAL / A11Y: Add DialogDescription (or VisuallyHidden one) inside the athlete-report-modal DialogContent in /app/frontend/src/pages/staff/EventReport.js (line ~707) to silence 'Missing Description' Radix warning.

OPTIONAL / CONTENT: In event_report_routes.py executive_summary builder, guard the 'main positive/attention point' sentence so it is NOT emitted when compliance.rate == 0 or overall.readiness is None (e.g., for the empty date range). Currently it says 'main positive was consistent daily data collection' even with 0% adherence.

OPTIONAL / UX: Recharts logs many 'width(-1)/height(-1)' warnings on first paint. Give ChartFrame an explicit minHeight (e.g., min-h-[220px]) or render chart only after ResponsiveContainer has size to remove noise.
critical_code_review_comments: event_report_routes.py is 749 lines with a single build_report function of ~550 lines. It works and is well-organized by section, but is above the 700-line soft limit and would benefit from being split into helpers per section (compliance, readiness, pain, load, recovery, availability, insights) in a package to make each section unit-testable in isolation.

EventReport.js is 855 lines including 8+ inline sub-components (HeaderStat, MiniStat, CompareRow, ProfileList, RecBlock, IndividualReport, plus helpers). Extract IndividualReport and the compare/rec/profile helpers into /components/eventreport/ (similar to primitives.jsx) to bring EventReport.js under ~500 lines.

EventReport athlete modal uses DialogContent without a DialogDescription — same a11y issue previously reported for recovery-proofs lightbox. Consider a shared wrapper component that enforces a description slot.

exportCSV builds CSV manually via string concatenation — fine for small payloads but consider using PapaParse (already in-tree if not, add) to correctly handle embedded newlines/quotes in athlete names or region labels.
Route /event-report is registered as a duplicate of /staff/event-report (App.js lines 79-80). Not harmful but worth deduping to reduce ambiguity in nav/analytics.

event_report_routes.py uses `.to_list(50000)` for each of readiness/recovery/sessions/alerts. For long seasons this can grow — consider a stricter, indexed query (e.g., pre-filter sessions by regex on date_time_start prefix, or store a normalized 'date' field) so the Python-side filter `sessions = [s for s in sessions if start <= (s.get('date_time_start') or '')[:10] <= end]` isn't needed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all required flows (nav, filters, view-switch, KPIs, sections, athlete modal, CSV, empty-state)
